intro: The Merlin Under Sink UTC Water Purifier is a premium under-sink RO water purification system designed for brackish water with TDS levels up to 2000 ppm. Equipped with a 7-stage purification process including Sediment, Pre-Carbon, RO Membrane, Copper + Zinc Mineral Cartridge, UV, UF, and TDS Adjuster, it delivers safe, healthy, and great-tasting drinking water. With a 15-litre storage tank, 12 LPH purification capacity, and free standard installation, it is an ideal solution for modern homes.

rows: Sediment, Pre-Carbon, RO, Copper + Zinc, UV, UF, Post Carbon
*Filter life may vary depending on the quality of the input water and usage conditions.
